test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**In the following passage, a word has been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Growing up in Bengaluru, I have watched the city grow and _________ at its seams, welcoming, as its own, all the ________ population in search of jobs and pleasant _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **flex, migrant, weather**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• Option 1 :__
 __
 
• **Retreat **means an act of moving back or withdrawing. (पीछे हटने की क्रिया)
 
• **Native **means a person born in a specified place or associated with a place by birth. (देशी)
 
• **Food **means something that people and animals eat, or plants absorb, to keep them alive. (भोजन)
 
 
 
• ​Option 2 :__
 __
 
• **Flex **means an act or instance of flexing or bending. (ठोके या झुकने की क्रिया या उदाहरण)
 
• **Migrant **means a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work or better living conditions. (प्रवासी)
 
• **Weather **means the state of the atmosphere with respect to wind, temperature, cloudiness, moisture, pressure, etc. (मौसम)
 
 
 
• ​Option 3 :__
 __
 
• **Curtail **means to reduce or limit something, or to stop something before it is finished. (कम करना)
 
• **Local **means relating or restricted to a particular area or one's neighbourhood. (स्थानीय)
 
• **Destination **means the place to which someone or something is going or being sent. (गंतव्य)
 
 
 
• ​Option 4 :__
 __
 
• **Demolish **means to completely destroy buildings or other structures. (धूल में मिलाना)
 
• **Foreign **means belonging or connected to a country that is not your own. (विदेशी)
 
• **Tourism **means the commercial organization and operation of holidays and visits to places of interest. (पर्यटन)
 
 

Therefore, as per the meaning of the above words **option 2** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

**Complete sentence:** *Growing up in Bengaluru, I have watched the city grow and **flex __**at its seams, welcoming, as its own, all the **__migrant __**population in search of jobs and pleasant **__weather__**.*
